evidence.quote:
./autogen.sh \
    --disable-shared \
    --without-debug \
    --without-http \
    --without-python
make -j$(nproc)

cd fuzz
make clean-corpus
make fuzz.o

for fuzzer in html regexp schema uri valid xinclude xml xpath; do
    make $fuzzer.o
    # Link with $CXX
    $CXX $CXXFLAGS \
        $fuzzer.o fuzz.o \
        -o $OUT/$fuzzer \
        $LIB_FUZZING_ENGINE \
        ../.libs/libxml2.a -Wl,-Bstatic -lz -llzma -Wl,-Bdynamic

observable_consequence.reason: A failed base allocation reaches the replacement helper, which has no direct errNo assignment. The getter still reads errNo and the existing check aborts on a mismatch, but xmlRaiseMemoryError's effect on errNo is not supplied.

alternatives_ruled_out.reason: The helper delegates to xmlRaiseMemoryError. Without that function and the installed handler behavior, an equivalent update to errNo cannot be ruled out.

identity_preserved.reason: The comparison uses the same document URL base allocation failure and the same old harness check on both source versions. Before, the called helper explicitly assigned XML_ERR_NO_MEMORY; after, it delegates reporting.
